ledger.note: 116 (the dossier's start, not a page's date): Hatra is a Parthian vassal for its whole life under the Arsacids. Kingdom of Hatra page (re-read 2026-10-19): infobox status 'Autonomous state, frequently a vassal of the Parthian Empire'; the lead says the kingdom lay 'mostly under Parthian suzerainty'; after Rome incorporated Edessa in 165 Hatra became 'the westernmost part of the Parthian Empire'; Sanatruq I page: 'He was granted the title of king by his Parthian overlord Vologases IV (r. 147-191)'; Hatra page infobox 'Satellite of: Parthian Empire' and 'a semi-autonomous buffer kingdom on the western limits of the Parthian Empire'. No page gives a year for the start of the suzerainty, so the year is the dossier's start and the confidence 1; 'frequently' means some stretches may have been independent, which no page dates. Mirrors a parthian-empire vassal_start for hatra that does not yet exist. [Added after review me-06-x, 2026-10-19]

c. 176/177: the lords of Hatra become kings, 'King of the Arabs'. Sanatruq I page: 'He was granted the title of king by his Parthian overlord Vologases IV (r. 147-191)'; his only dated inscription is 176/177. Kingdom of Hatra page: 'From the 170s they adopted malka (king)', linked to Rome's incorporation of Edessa in 165, which made Hatra the westernmost part of the Parthian Empire. The Hatra page says the reign of Sanatruq I is about 140 to 180; Nasru's reign differs by page.

wars.name: Trajan's siege of Hatra

wars.name: Severan sieges of Hatra
wars.outcome: Septimius Severus failed to take Hatra, as Trajan had; Abdsamiya had supported Pescennius Niger.
wars.note: Hatra page: 'Septimius Severus, 197-198 and 198/199'; the Parthian Empire page: he retreated in late 198 after failing to take Hatra.

wars.outcome: Ardashir's attempt failed; Hatra withstood him in the 220s.
